title: Modified induction and a torsion-theoretic equivalence for relative BiHom-Hopf modules
summary: We develop an induction theory for relative BiHom-Hopf modules, the special BiHom-Doi--Hopf case associated with the datum $(H,A,H)$ in which the final copy of $H$ carries its regular right $H$-module coalgebra structure. Let $H$ be a monoidal BiHom-Hopf algebra, let $A$ be a right $H$-BiHom-comodule algebra, and let $B=A^{\operatorname{co}H}$. We show that the balanced tensor product defines an induction functor $-\otimes_BA$ left adjoint to the coinvariant functor.
